column1: # Everyday words (Dutch and English) for NEVO foods whose NEVO name uses other words,
# so "havermout" finds oat flakes and "boterham" finds bread. The app's own list, not NEVO data.
# The first NEVO code is the usual pick; search shows these foods first, in this order.
# Vegetables NEVO names otherwise (Round 15): same food, or the closest NEVO food where noted.
